minutes_text:
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  WATER ADMINISTRATION ASSEMBLY ROOM, 7:00 PM

Gina Maguire, President  Charles Parkin, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 7:00 PM, President Maguire called the meeting to order.

 President Maguire welcomed attendees and thanked them for their participation. The meeting was
 dedicated in memory of former Commissioner Robert E. Shannon, who recently passed away. A
 moment of silence was observed in his honor.

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Parkin, Cordero, Scott, Maguire

 Commissioners Absent: Rainey

 President Maguire excused Commissioner Rainey from the August 27, 2025 Special Meeting.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56230  Consider the timely written objections by ratepayers to the proposed water and
  sewer rate schedules for Fiscal Year 2025-2026 and the corresponding Long
  Beach Public Utilities Department’s responses, and determine to proceed with the
  Proposition 218 protest hearing pursuant to the requirements of Government Code
  Section 53759.1.

  A motion was made by Vice President Scott, seconded by Secretary Cordero,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Parkin, Cordero, Scott, Maguire
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  WATER ADMINISTRATION ASSEMBLY ROOM, 7:00 PM

  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Rainey

  The Board called for a brief recess at 7:05 PM due to technical difficulties and
  reconvened at 7:07 PM.

  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney, provided the staff report.

HEARING

2  25-56232  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record on the
  proposed increase to the City’s Water and Sewer Rates for Fiscal Year 2025-2026;
  receive public comment pursuant to Proposition 218; and, in the absence of a
  majority protest, conclude the public hearing.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, provided the staff report.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Mr. Whitehead spoke.
Dania Mousa spoke.
Elizabeth Henriquez spoke in Spanish and interpreted by staff.
Rosario Chavez spoke in Spanish and interpreted by staff.
Vivian Green spoke.
Christopher Graeber spoke.
K. Chun spoke.
Glynder Striggs spoke.

Secretary Cordero spoke.
Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.
President Maguire spoke.
Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney, spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 8:02 PM, President Maguire adjourned the meeting.
